content: {"reasoning":"The CO-50 denial persists after correction and resubmission, so repeating the claim unchanged is unlikely to resolve the payer’s invalid diagnosis/procedure pairing. A formal medical-necessity appeal can use the clinic documentation to address the denial without inventing coding changes; prior authorization is not required and peer-to-peer review is unavailable. The payer appeal path remains available, so neither billing the full balance to the patient nor writing it off is appropriate.","action":"appeal_with_necessity"}
